title: Abelian etale sheaves on a field and discrete G-modules
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K^sep a separable closure, and G=Gal(K^sep/K). Taking the geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] at Spec K^sep induces an equivalence between abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on the small etale site of Spec K and discrete G-modules. The equivalence is compatible with the underlying sheaf-of-sets/G-set equivalence and with the abelian group operations.
